title: Retro lab 2 (source of the round-2 templates)
summary: The 8 comps the round-2 Retro templates were built and verified in: 70s stripe lower third, VHS overlay, groovy badge, neon sign, chrome title, TV switch-off, arcade start screen and venetian blinds.
use_when: You want to see a round-2 retro template working before using it, copy a comp's objects, or re-extract a template with comp_to_template.py.

comps: RT Chrome title (90 f, text gradient)

carvercat_version: built and verified in Carvercat 0.1.6 (rev 1105,; public release binary, headless; pack added to the bundled Library for the test), 2026-10-27
copy_notes: Comps have a 'Lab bg' rectangle (dropped on extraction) except RT TV off and RT Blinds.
Clip ids are unique per comp (rlt_, rvh_, rgb_, rns_, rch_, rtv_, ras_, rbl_).
Rebuild: ai/scripts/motion/retro_lab2.py writes the comps; apply its PRESETS with preset.apply, then edit.save.
Every comp lints 0 errors / 0 warnings; qc at 240 px finds no flashes.
